items.headline: Flood Warning issued May 11 at 8:25PM AKDT until May 12 at 10:00PM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:

* WHERE...Hughes.

items.headline: Flood Advisory issued May 11 at 4:31PM AKDT until May 12 at 10:00AM AKDT by NWS Anchorage AK
items.description:

items.headline: Flood Watch issued May 11 at 4:30PM AKDT until May 12 at 10:00AM AKDT by NWS Anchorage AK
items.description:
* WHAT...Flooding caused by an ice jam is possible.

* WHERE...Kalskag, Kwethluk, Akiak and Tuluksak

* WHEN...Through Tuesday morning.

* IMPACTS...Ice jams may result in flooding of rivers, creeks,
sloughs, and other low-lying flood prone locations. Water may
impound behind a jam which may cause flooding several miles
upstream.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...

reports that an ice jam is still in place near Lower Kalsgag.

items.headline: Hydrologic Outlook issued May 11 at 11:07AM AKDT by NWS Fairbanks AK
items.description:
ESFAFG

...Locations Impacted...
Rampart and Tanana.

The Yukon River breakup front is currently downstream of Rampart.
The River Watch team will fly to Tanana today (Monday May 11th) to
report on surrounding ice conditions. Updates will be posted as
available.
